title: Questions and negation
summary: Say what something is not with *däl*, ask yes-no questions with `-mY` written onto the word, ask who, what, which, when and why, and say **too** with *hem*.
canDo: Say what you and other people are not
Ask yes-no questions and answer them
Ask who, what, which, when, why and how much
Say me too, and both … and
